title: Planner Agent — Google-Style Multi-Agent Agentic RAG
description: The Planner Agent transforms user questions into structured execution plans with subtasks, complexity classification, retrieval domain selection, and reasoning type prediction. This is the first reasoning component in the Agentic RAG workflow.

userStories.title: Plan and SubTask Pydantic models
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Pydantic models for Plan and SubTask so the Planner has a typed contract for its output.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/agents/planner/models.py
Plan model has fields: objective (str), complexity_score (float), retrieval_domains (list[str]), subtasks (list[SubTask]), reasoning_type (str), estimated_iterations (int)
SubTask model has fields: id (str), type (str), objective (str), retrieval_sources (list[str]), priority (int), expected_output (str)
Add ReasoningType enum: FACT_LOOKUP, EXPLANATION, COMPARISON, MULTI_HOP, PERSONALIZED, SOCRATIC, REMEDIATION
Add ComplexityLevel enum: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH
All models are Pydantic BaseModel classes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Planner Agent system prompts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want structured system prompts for the Planner Agent so it produces consistent, well-formatted plans.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/agents/planner/prompts.py
PLANNER_SYSTEM_PROMPT instructs the LLM to: understand the objective, break into retrieval tasks, determine knowledge sources, estimate complexity, produce a structured plan
The prompt explicitly says: Do not answer the question. Do not retrieve documents. Only produce a plan.
The prompt includes output format instructions with JSON schema for Plan and SubTask
The prompt includes examples of simple vs complex query planning
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: PlannerAgent class with plan generation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a PlannerAgent class that extends BaseAgent and generates plans from user queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/agents/planner/planner.py
PlannerAgent extends BaseAgent from src/agents/base.py
PlannerAgent has method: async def generate_plan(self, user_query: str, learner_snapshot: dict | None = None) -> Plan
generate_plan calls self._call_llm with PLANNER_SYSTEM_PROMPT and the user query
generate_plan parses the LLM response as JSON and constructs Plan and SubTask objects
If parsing fails, returns a fallback Plan with complexity=LOW, single curriculum subtask
If learner_snapshot is provided, includes personalization signals in the prompt
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: PlannerNode for LangGraph integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a PlannerNode that wraps PlannerAgent for LangGraph graph execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/graph/nodes/planner.py
PlannerNode class takes ModelRouter in __init__
PlannerNode has method: async def __call__(self, state: AgentState) -> AgentState
__call__ creates PlannerAgent, calls generate_plan with state.user_message and state.learner_snapshot
__call__ sets state.execution_plan = plan.model_dump(), state.subtasks = [s.model_dump() for s in plan.subtasks], state.complexity_score = plan.complexity_score
If state.learner_snapshot is empty, passes None to generate_plan
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Planner Agent unit tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unit tests for the Planner Agent to verify plan generation, complexity classification, and domain selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/agents/test_planner.py
Test Plan model validates required fields
Test SubTask model validates required fields
Test ReasoningType enum has all expected values
Test ComplexityLevel enum has all expected values
Test PlannerAgent.generate_plan with mocked LLM returns valid Plan
Test PlannerAgent.generate_plan with failing LLM returns fallback Plan
Test PlannerNode updates AgentState correctly
Tests mock _call_llm on the agent instance (per existing test convention)
Tests pass
